title: epipactis foliosa
intro: Epipactis foliosa, commonly known as the Fan-leaved Helleborine, is a rare and endangered species of orchid native to China. It is used in traditional Chinese medicine, valued for its purported health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and act as an antiseptic. The therapeutic actions of Epipactis foliosa include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe and protect the skin, as well as its potential to treat various infections. The bioactive constituents of Epipactis foliosa include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
